A.rule: No new science in the materializer; replay, current-authority reconciliation, build, visual/content audit, exact package and closure receipt only.

B1.rule: Use the strongest already-earned bounded result, reconcile stale readiness/authority records, integrate authoritative negatives, independently replay, then materialize a venue-specific package. Wider top-tier gates remain optional successor research.

B2.rule: Execute up to three materially distinct frozen theorem/realization rounds. Promote only on earned evidence; otherwise package the strongest existing theorem/structural result as a narrower specialist paper.

C.rule: Attempt the highest-value executable discriminator under public/mechanical authority. If unavailable or negative after the stop rule, freeze the strongest honest theory/method/interface paper rather than fabricating external authority.
